summary: The Georgia list places a hancock mill tower in Richmond County; a 2013 secondhand report of two tower auctions, one in Richmond County, does not name either tower. No source describes the site today.

The entry gives no unit for its elevation value
For towers 73 and above the list's names are the compiler's own
evidence.quote: (For towers 73 and above, names are my creation.)

evidence.supports: One of the two towers is in Richmond County near Augusta and the other in Pulaski County

sources.title: Georgia/South Carolina Chapter Representative Report for 2013

notes_for_editor: The 2013 report is a secondhand chapter report ('I understand') that names no tower, so its auction cannot be matched to this site; the list has four other Richmond County entries (GA285 tobacoo rd, GA368 reid, GA403 steadman, GA404 walton). The note 'prescott' and code gfc-028 are unexplained. A Massachusetts Prescott tower surfaced in search and is unrelated. Two web searches found no other page; the cached NHLR and FFLOS Georgia indexes do not list this name, and the live registers refused the connection. The record's 110.0 m elevation assumes feet (361 ft); the list gives no unit. Story is about 171 words.
